description.value:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the rift

Effect The triggering creature takes 6d10+20 damage as its body rapidly ages. It must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes clumsy 2 and enfeebled 2, and becomes slowed for 1 minute.

details.description: A rift in time rapidly ages and slows anyone who draws near.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:36] (master) or Occultism (master) to magically mend time, @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) to repair the time rift, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rift
